mission.objective: Design the next-generation router kernel's state model
mission.title: Design the routing kernel's owner-scoped state model
mission.task: Design the state model for the routing kernel: how a mission's candidate-node graph, its dispatch history, and per-node worker affinity should be represented and persisted so that a crash mid-dispatch can reconcile cleanly. This is a from-scratch design decision that will constrain every future routing slice, not an implementation task — propose the shape, the invariants, and the failure modes it forecloses.
